newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Enami signs $70 mln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Enami signs $70 mln syndicated loan.

text.p: Chile's state-owned copper company Empresa Nacional de Mineria (Enami) signed Wednesday a $70 million loan with a group of banks led by France's Societe Generale.
The loan will be used to finance the clean-up and modernization of Enami's Paipote and Ventanas smelting and refining complexes, said Enami vice president Claudio Agostini.
"The funds will contribute towards the development and modernization of Enami," he said at the signing ceremony.
The loan will be for seven years, he said.
Enami plans to invest $150 million in modernizing and expanding the plants which must meet new tough environment standards coming into force over the next two years.
The Paipote smelter has a processing capacity of 260,000 tonnes of concentrates a year, while the Ventanas smelter and refinery which treats 330,000 tonnes of copper a year.
